breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the laminar formula 'Le = 0.06 Re D' verbatim, directly repeating the original error. It should have identified this as a laminar correlation inapplicable to turbulent flow.

breakdown.description: Turbulent entrance length is typically O(10–60) diameters and is much less sensitive to Re.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not mention the turbulent entrance-length guideline (Le ≈ 10D–60D). It continues to use the Re-proportional laminar scaling, failing to reflect that turbulent entrance length is much shorter and less sensitive to Re.
